args.title: Clarify error message for malformed row import issue
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The existing error message 'Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header' in src/i18n/en.json misleadingly suggests that the issue is with column count. This proposal suggests rewording the error message to better reflect the issue with handling multi-line memos in imports, ensuring users understand the nature of the problem more accurately and might include actionable next steps.
